court.label: Court of Justice of the European Union

proposition.statement: Consent for cookie storage or access is not validly constituted by a pre-checked checkbox that the user must deselect to refuse.

guardrails: The judgment is an interpretation, not a textual mutation of Article 5(3).
The judgment date is not promoted to a new application-start date.
This holding object does not assert a generic temporal effect for preliminary rulings.
notes: Proof case for authoritative interpretation without a fabricated prospective valid-time boundary.
